t: This is a bust of Sir Henry Tate, here in Brixton. Tate was a sugar merchant and philanthropist, known for establishing the Tate Gallery and Henry Tate & Sons, which later became Tate & Lyle. The sculptor was Thomas Brock, described as the undisputed leading British sculptor of his day. Brock's most famous work is the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace, and he also completed the statue of Prince Albert on the Albert Memorial.
